summary: Two commissioners who lose a recommendation vote put their own reasons before the people who have the final say.
realLife: Two Arlington Heights plan commissioners opposed the recommendation to reject Lincoln Green and submitted a minority report supporting rezoning before the trustees considered the project.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with commissioner, report, project. A trustee can ask a dissenter to explain the case for the site.

turns.what: The dissent reaches a trustee after the agenda packet goes out.
turns.pulledBy: The dissenters finish writing before the trustees vote.
turns.writesBack: The clerk circulates the signed report as a supplement.

turns.what: One dissenter favors the apartments and declines to endorse the other member's parking argument.
turns.pulledBy: The two agree on the vote but have submitted separately signed statements.
turns.writesBack: The trustees receive both statements with the vote tally.
